newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BankBoston started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BankBoston started as buy.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities said on Monday it started coverage of BankBoston Corp with a buy rating.

-- "We are initiating coverage of BankBoston with a buy rating, and we forecast a nearly 25 percent total return for BankBoston stock over the next 12 months," analysts Catherine Murray and Sheila Reilly wrote in a report.

-- "We foresee superior earnings growth in the near term and above-average growth in the medium term resulting from the July closing of the BayBanks acquisition, the increased commitment to Latin America ... and an effective strategy to increase top-line growth," they said.
